scope: empirical W02 audit; not a formal benchmark result

motion_formulation.observed_coordinate_interpretation: world/inertial coordinates: moving tank boundary coordinates change

accelerated_frame_formulation.observed_coordinate_interpretation: tank-attached coordinates: fixed boundaries remain fixed while AccInput supplies non-inertial forcing

claims.idp: Stable in these fixed-resolution probes; it identifies numerical SPH particles, not independently verified material parcels.
claims.position_velocity: With shifting disabled, exported velocity approximately transports exported position over a short output interval. With shifting enabled, position includes additional numerical shifting displacement, so Vel alone is not the full trajectory derivative.
claims.reference_frames: Motion and AccInput formulations expose different coordinate conventions and must carry explicit world/body transform metadata.
claims.scope_limit: No claim is made here for variable-resolution split/merge identity; its (Zone,Idp) key remains numerical-node identity only.
